title: Zesty Crunchy American Bean Casserole
description: Earthy, zesty bean casserole with a crunchy breadcrumb topping, perfect for a quick hangover cure.

ingredients.name: spice mix
ingredients.notes: ground cumin, smoked paprika, fenugreek seeds, dried red chili flakes

instructions: Rinse the soaked beans, place them in a pot with 3 cups water, bring to a boil, simmer 45 minutes until tender, then drain and set aside.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat, add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the spice mix and cook for another minute to toast the spices.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a simmer, then stir in the cooked beans, cilantro, and lime juice; season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the bean mixture into individual mini cocottes, top each with shredded cheese and panko breadcrumbs.
Dot the top with 1 teaspoon butter each and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese melts and the crumbs turn golden.
After removing from oven, let the casseroles cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm with a sprinkle of fresh cilantro.
